usage: The word '樓盤' refers to a property listing, usually for buying or renting houses or apartments.
It is a noun and can be used to talk about a specific property listing or the collection of listings on a website or in an agency.
You can use '樓盤' with words like '睇' (to view) or '搵' (to find) to describe searching for property listings.
It often appears in contexts related to real estate agents, property websites, or newspapers.
You can say '有冇新嘅樓盤？' (Are there any new property listings?) to ask about available properties.
